name: razor
description: YAGNI checkpoints at the harness level for real engineering work — nudges toward the simplest solution and asks one evidence-backed "do we need this?" before new dependencies, file sprawl, and unchecked build growth.

interface.shortDescription: Do we even need this? One check before adding more.
interface.longDescription: razor puts a short reuse-first checklist in front of Codex, with one-shot checks for new dependencies, file sprawl, and unchecked build growth. Its unused-dependency skill reports existing dead weight without changing your project.
defaultPrompt: Find unused dependencies in this project.
